paragraphs: Viatris is a global healthcare company whose breadth and scale we believe make it uniquely positioned to address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, Viatris supplies high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world each year. The Company has a global footprint, an extensive portfolio of medicines that is well-diversified across therapeutic areas, a one-of-a-kind global supply chain designed to reach more people when and where they need them, and the scientific expertise to address some of the world's most enduring health challenges.

Viatris' executive management team is focused on ensuring that the Company is optimally structured and efficiently resourced to deliver sustainable value to patients, shareholders, customers and other key stakeholders. The Company operates in more than 165 countries and territories with more than 30,000 employees. The Company has 27 manufacturing, packaging, and distribution sites worldwide, more than 1,400 approved molecules, and what we believe is industry leading commercial, R&D, regulatory, manufacturing, legal and medical expertise. Viatris' portfolio consists of generics (including complex products), globally recognized iconic brands, and an expanding portfolio of innovative medicines. Viatris is headquartered in the U.S., with global centers in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Shanghai, China and Hyderabad, India.
A Strong Foundation for Performance and Impact
We believe that Viatris' ability to sustainably deliver high-quality medicines is grounded in its mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life.

Viatris has executed various strategic initiatives, transactions and business arrangements over the last few years to return its base business to growth, deliver on its pipeline, reduce debt, and return capital to shareholders. The Company has also completed certain divestiture-related transactions to simplify and streamline its business, accelerate paydown of debt and unlock value as discussed below.

•In November 2022, Viatris completed a transaction to contribute its biosimilars portfolio to Biocon Biologics to create a vertically integrated global biosimilars leader, for a combination of cash and stock in the form of CCPS representing a stake of approximately 12.9% (on a fully diluted basis) in Biocon Biologics.

•In March 2024, the Company completed the divestiture of its women's healthcare business, primarily related to its oral and injectable contraceptives, to Insud Pharma, S.L., a leading Spanish multinational pharmaceutical company. The transaction included two manufacturing facilities in India: one in Ahmedabad and one in Sarigam.

•In June 2024, the Company completed the divestiture of its API business in India to Matrix Pharma Private Limited, a privately held pharmaceutical company based in India. The transaction included three manufacturing sites and an R&D lab in Hyderabad, three manufacturing sites in Vizag and third-party API sales. Viatris retained some selective R&D capabilities in API.

•In July 2024, the Company completed the divestiture of its OTC Business to Cooper Consumer Health, a leading European OTC drug manufacturer and distributor. The transaction included two manufacturing sites located in Merignac, France, and Confienza, Italy, and an R&D site in Monza, Italy. The Company retained the rights for Viagra®, Dymista® (which, in certain limited markets, are sold as OTC products) and select OTC products in certain markets.

•Viatris divested its rights to women's healthcare products Duphaston® and Femoston® in certain countries to Theramex HQ UK Limited, a leading global specialty pharmaceutical company dedicated to women's health. The transaction (other than in the U.K., which was sold to Insud Pharma, S.L. in August 2024) closed in December 2023.
•The divestitures of the commercialization rights in the majority of the Upjohn Distributor Markets closed during 2023 and 2024.
In 2025, Viatris continued to reshape its business while delivering meaningful progress for shareholders, patients, and employees alike. Among this year's achievements:
•Strong Commercial Execution: Viatris reported 2025 total revenues of $14.30 billion, despite the impact of divestitures and the Indore Impact, demonstrating renewed momentum in our base business.

headings: Healthcare reform legislation could have a material adverse effect on our business.
We have significant operations globally, which exposes us to the risks inherent in conducting our business internationally.

The illegal distribution and sale by third parties of counterfeit or IP-infringing versions of our products or of diverted or stolen products could have a negative impact on our reputation and our business.
We face vigorous competition that threatens the commercial acceptance and pricing of our products.
A relatively small group of products may represent a significant portion of our revenues, net sales, gross profit, or net earnings from time to time.
Current and changing economic conditions, including inflation, may adversely affect our industry, business, partners and suppliers.
The pharmaceutical industry is heavily regulated, and we face significant costs and uncertainties associated with our efforts to comply with applicable laws and regulations.
paragraphs: We operate in a complex and rapidly changing environment that involves risks, many of which are beyond our control. Our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, ability to pay dividends or repurchase shares, and/or stock price could be materially affected by any of these risks, if they occur, or by other factors not currently known to us, or not currently considered to be material. These risk factors should be read in conjunction with the other information in this Form 10-K, as well as our other filings with the SEC.
Our risk factors are organized into five categories: Strategic, Operational, Compliance, Finance and General.

Below is a summary of some of the more significant risks and uncertainties we face. This summary is not exhaustive and is qualified by reference to the full set of risk factors set forth in this Part I, Item 1A.

◦We may not realize the intended benefits of, or achieve the intended goals or outlooks with respect to, our strategic initiatives and priorities, including our enterprise-wide strategic review and other potential corporate transactions.

◦Viatris' restructuring activities may not achieve their intended goals and may present significant challenges, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, ability to pay dividends or repurchase shares, and/or stock price.

◦There are risks and uncertainties associated with divestitures, product rationalizations and asset sales, one or more of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, ability to pay dividends or repurchase shares, and/or stock price.

paragraphs: Viatris 是一家全球醫療保健公司，我們相信其廣度與規模使其能獨特地應對全球醫療需求。以「賦能全球人民在生命各階段擁有更健康生活」為使命，Viatris 每年為全世界約 10 億名患者提供高品質的藥物。本公司擁有全球足跡，藥物產品組合廣泛且分散於多個治療領域，具有一體化的全球供應鏈，能於需要時及需要地點觸及更多人，並擁有科學專業知識以應對世界一些最持久的健康挑戰。

Viatris 的高階管理團隊專注於確保本公司結構最佳化且資源運用效率，以持續為患者、股東、客戶及其他關鍵利害關係人創造價值。本公司在超過 165 個國家及地區營運，擁有超過 3 萬名員工。本公司在全球擁有 27 個製造、包裝及配送據點，超過 1,400 種已核准分子，並擁有我們認為是產業領先的商業、研發、法規、製造、法律及醫療專業知識。Viatris 的產品組合包含一般用藥（包括複雜產品）、 globally recognized iconic brands，以及不斷擴張的創新藥物組合。Viatris 董事會設於美國，並在全球設有總部於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡、中國上海及印度海得拉巴。
強大的績效與影響力基礎
我們相信 Viatris 能持續提供高品質藥物的能力，是基於其使命，賦能全球人民在生命各階段擁有更健康生活。
Viatris 在過去幾年執行了多項戰略計畫、交易及商業安排，以恢復其核心業務成長、實現其產品線、減少債務，並回饋資本給股東。本公司也完成了一些與資產處置相關的交易，以簡化及優化其業務，加速償還債務並釋放價值，如下列所討論。
•2022 年 11 月，Viatris 完成一項交易，將其生物相似藥產品組合貢獻給 Biocon Biologics，以建立一個垂直整合的全球生物相似藥領導者，交易形式為現金與股票組合，以 CCPS 形式代表約 12.9%（完全稀釋後）的 Biocon Biologics 股權。
•2024 年 3 月，本公司完成其婦女健康業務（主要為口服及注射避孕藥）的資產處置，出售給 Insud Pharma, S.L.，一家西班牙領先的國際藥品公司。交易包含印度的兩個製造廠：一個在艾哈邁達巴德，一個在薩里加姆。
•2024 年 6 月，本公司完成其印度 API 事業的資產處置，出售給 Matrix Pharma Private Limited，一家設於印度的私人藥品公司。交易包含 Hyderabad 的三個製造廠及一個研發實驗室、Vizag 的三個製造廠及第三方 API 售賣。Viatris 保留了一些選擇性的 API 研發能力。
•民國113年7月，本公司完成將其OTC業務出售給Cooper Consumer Health，為歐洲領先的OTC藥品製造與經銷商。此交易包含位於法國梅里尼亞克（Merignac）與義大利康菲涅扎（Confienza）的兩處製造廠，以及位於義大利蒙扎（Monza）的研發中心。本公司保留Viagra®、Dymista®（在某些有限市場中以OTC產品銷售）及部分OTC產品在特定市場的權利。
•Viatris將其在某些國家的女性健康產品Duphaston®與Femoston®的權利出售給Theramex HQ UK Limited，為專注於女性健康的全球領先專門藥品公司。此交易（除英國外，英國於民國113年8月出售給Insud Pharma, S.L.）於民國112年12月完成。
•在Upjohn Distributor Markets中，大多數商業化權利的出售於民國112年及民國113年完成。
民國114年，Viatris持續重塑其業務，同時為股東、病人與員工帶來顯著進展。本年度的成就包括：
•強勁的商業執行：Viatris報告民國114年總營業收入為143億美元，儘管受到出售業務與Indore Impact的影響，顯示本公司核心業務重新恢復動能。
◦本公司推動創新產品線，取得五項正面的第三期臨牀試驗數據結果：

paragraphs: 我們營運於一個複雜且快速變化的環境中，其中包含許多風險，許多風險超出了我們的控制範圍。我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、支付股息或回購股份的能力，以及/或股票價格，可能因這些風險發生，或因其他尚未為我們所知或目前未被認為具有重大影響的因素而受到重大影響。這些風險因素應與本Form 10-K中的其他資訊，以及我們向SEC提交的其他申報文件一併閱讀。
我們的風險因素被歸類為五大類別：戰略、營運、合規、財務及一般性風險。
以下為我們所面臨的一些較為重要的風險與不確定性總結。此總結並非完整，且應參照本Part I, Item 1A中所列的完整風險因素。
◦我們可能無法實現戰略計畫與優先事項的預期效益，或達成預期的目標或展望，包括我們企業層面的戰略評估及其他潛在企業交易。
◦Viatris的重整活動可能無法達成預期目標，並可能面臨重大挑戰，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、支付股息或回購股份的能力，以及/或股票價格造成重大不利影響。
◦與資產處置、產品精簡及資產銷售相關的風險與不確定性，其中一項或數項可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、支付股息或回購股份的能力，以及/或股票價格造成重大不利影響。
